name: Vuln Analyzer
description: Audits taint slices with code evidence, classifies CWEs, and formulates hypotheses.

skills.name: Audit flows
skills.description: Inspect guards, sanitizers, and bounds along slices and cite concrete file:line evidence.
examples: Audit source-to-sink slice for logic or technical flaws with code citations

skills.name: Synthesize hypothesis
skills.description: Produce structured vulnerability hypotheses with preconditions, triggers, and oracles.
examples: Formulate verifiable hypothesis JSON for downstream PoV testing

skills.name: Defend findings
skills.description: Defend candidate hypotheses against debator challenges using line-level code proof.
examples: Answer debator challenges with concrete bypass proof or concede benign
